summary: Join our Anti-Bribery and Corruption Laws Training Course to understand key legal frameworks and ensure your business operates ethically and responsibly.
lede: Anti-bribery and corruption training helps governance, compliance, procurement and operations professionals recognize improper conduct and assess organizational risks. Participants learn to vet third parties, spot warning signs, and develop policies and controls for gifts, hospitality and conflicts of interest. The course also covers reporting concerns, handling investigations fairly, and monitoring compliance measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in governance, compliance, procurement, or operations.
audience: Project and operations managers in high-risk sectors
Internal audit and risk management professionals
modules: Anti-Corruption in Public and NGO Sectors
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of corporate governance and ethical practices. Prior experience in compliance or risk management is beneficial but not required.
